methodologyNotes: 13 notable evaporative ('swamp') coolers selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, scoped to portable/personal units directly comparable on airflow, tank size, and coverage (duct-in whole-house/window systems use an incompatible spec shape and are out of scope). All 10 seeds from the brief were checked against manufacturer sites and corrected where the market had moved: 'Portacool Jetstream 250' does not exist under that name — Portacool's real legacy line was Jetstream 220/230/260/270 and Cyclone 120/130/140/160, and portacool.com confirms both series are now fully discontinued ('Parts and accessories are available' only); the current Portacool (a Big Ass Fans brand) lineup is the APEX series (500/700/1200/2000/4000/6500), so the seed was replaced with APEX 700 (closest personal/patio-class successor) plus APEX 4000 added for the large industrial tier. 'Frigidaire EC300WF' was corrected to its real model number EC300W-FA; its owner's manual is hosted with a registration link at register.newair.com, indicating NewAir now services this Frigidaire-licensed SKU. 'Big Ass Fans Cool-Space' is confirmed real and current at bigassfans.com/evaporative-coolers (300/350/400/500 tiers); Cool-Space 300 was selected as the representative mid-tier unit. Honeywell CO60PM and CL30XC are both confirmed-real, officially spec-sheeted products (manufactured by JMATEK under Honeywell license, spec PDFs dated (c)2016) but honeywellstore.com now shows both as 'DISCONTINUED' with no current US price anywhere checked (Amazon, Home Depot, Lowe's all blocked automated access) — included as still-relevant, frequently second-hand/eBay-compared reference points, priceUsd null; Honeywell CO25AE (smaller tier, also discontinued) was added to round out the Honeywell size range from compact to commercial. Vagkri is a real Amazon-exclusive brand (thevagkri.com is a marketing page that funnels directly to its Amazon store) sold under several near-identical ASINs for the same 2100 CFM unit; no independent US price could be extracted from Amazon's JS-rendered page. COSTWAY was resolved to a specific, verifiable SKU: the 3450 CFM 4-in-1 industrial cooler (Home Depot SKU GHM0665; also sold on Target and Best Buy) — costway.com itself blocked every fetch attempt (403), so target.com serves as the primary source. Luma Comfort EC45S was added as one of the most commonly compared budget indoor tower units, rounding the set to 13. specKeys chosen for real comparability across all units: airflow_cfm, water_tank_gal, coverage_sqft, speed_settings (discrete count; left null for continuously-variable-speed industrial units like the Portacool APEX and Cool-Space lines, which do not publish a discrete number), oscillation, ice_compartment, power_watt, runtime_hr (left null almost everywhere — manufacturers rarely publish an hours-per-fill figure; only Big Ass Fans Cool-Space 300 states one explicitly). true/false values were only set where a source's comprehensive feature/spec list positively confirmed presence or, for a thorough enumerated list, confirmed absence by omission (e.g. Honeywell's icon-grid spec sheets, Frigidaire's 14-feature + 20-part manual list); every other gap is null rather than a guess. priceUsd = current US MSRP or verified current retail price; several heavily bot-protected retailers (Amazon, Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart, Costway.com, newair.com, lumacomfort.com — most returned 403/429/CAPTCHA on repeated attempts) could not be scraped directly, so those products carry priceUsd:null with a priceNote explaining what was and wasn't confirmed, per null-beats-a-guess. accessedAt 2026-08-01 on all entries.

products.name: Hessaire MC37M 3,100 CFM Portable Evaporative Cooler
products.priceNote: Ace Hardware list price $459.99 as of 2026-08-01 (item #4839262). Sold under closely related SKU variants MC37M/MC37V/MC37VT/MC37MT representing the same 3,100 CFM chassis across retailers (Tractor Supply, Walmart, Home Depot); Hessaire's own site does not list a price.
products.provenance: hessaire.com's 3100-CFM mobile cooler page confirms model variants MC37V/MC37VT/M150/MC37M/MC37MT share this chassis: 3100 CFM, 10.3-gallon tank, 24x16x38in, 40 lbs, 2.4A/250W; no price or coverage figure given by the manufacturer. Ace Hardware (item #4839262) independently confirms 950 sq ft coverage and lists $459.99 as of 2026-08-01. Tractor Supply and Walmart listings corroborate the 950 sq ft / 3-speed / oscillating-vent description. Ice compartment not mentioned by any source checked, left null rather than assumed absent.

products.name: Hessaire MC61M 5,300 CFM Portable Evaporative Cooler
products.priceNote: Ace Hardware list price $679.99 as of 2026-08-01 (item #4839270). Also sold as MC61V/MC61VT variants; Hessaire's own site does not list a price.
products.provenance: hessaire.com's 5300-CFM mobile cooler page confirms model variants MC61V/MC61VT/M270R/M250/MC61MT share this chassis: 5300 CFM, 14.6-gallon tank, 28x17x46in, 57 lbs, 4.3A/430W. Ace Hardware (item #4839270) confirms 1600 sq ft coverage and lists $679.99 as of 2026-08-01; Home Depot and Lowe's listings (titles only, pages blocked automated access) corroborate the '5,300 CFM 3-Speed' description. Oscillation and ice compartment not confirmed either way by any source successfully fetched, left null.

products.name: Honeywell CO60PM Indoor/Outdoor Evaporative Air Cooler
products.priceNote: Discontinued — honeywellstore.com displays 'this item has been DISCONTINUED' as of 2026-08-01, with no current price or in-stock listing found at any retailer checked (Amazon page loaded but price was not extractable from the rendered fragment).
products.provenance: Official (c)2016 JMATEK/Honeywell spec-sheet PDF confirms: 1540 CFM (2610 m3/hr), 850 sq ft coverage, 15.9-gallon tank, 220W, 3 speeds (High/Medium/Low), continuous water supply connection, 3-side honeycomb media, 27.6x18.3x40in, 41 lbs; the full features icon grid (weather-resistance, low power, water capacity, 3 speeds, continuous water, honeycomb media, wide fan blades) does not include oscillation or an ice compartment, so both are set false rather than null. honeywellstore.com's own product page (fetched 2026-08-01) confirms the same 1540 CFM/850 sq ft/15.9 gal/220W/65dB figures and explicitly states the item is discontinued with no replacement price. A separate Honeywell global site (honeywellaircomfort.com) lists a differing '2697 CFM / 1643 sq ft' figure for what it calls the same model, likely a different regional test standard or later hardware revision not sold in the US; the US honeywellstore.com figures are used as primary.

products.name: Honeywell CL30XC Indoor Portable Evaporative Air Cooler
products.priceNote: Discontinued — honeywellstore.com displays 'this item has been DISCONTINUED' as of 2026-08-01, with no current price found.
products.provenance: Official (c)2016 JMATEK/Honeywell spec-sheet PDF confirms: 525 CFM (900 m3/hr), 320 sq ft coverage, 7.9-gallon tank, 288W, 3 speeds, oscillating louvers, adjustable humidification, low water alarm, top-loading ice compartment, LCD control panel + remote, 18x13.8x33.7in, 24.9 lbs. honeywellstore.com's product page (fetched 2026-08-01, alt text confirms the images shown are for the CL30XC despite a legacy 'co30xe' filename) confirms the item is discontinued with no current price; a replacement-model link is offered but not itself a CL30XC listing.

products.name: Honeywell CO25AE Indoor/Outdoor Evaporative Air Cooler
products.priceNote: Discontinued — honeywellstore.com displays 'this item has been DISCONTINUED' as of 2026-08-01, with no current price found.

products.name: NewAir AF-1000B Portable Evaporative Cooler
products.priceNote: newair.com rate-limited (HTTP 429) on every fetch attempt as of 2026-08-01; no current price could be independently confirmed from another live source.
products.provenance: Manufacturer-issued spec sheet (PDF distributed via Amazon's media CDN) confirms: Model AF-1000B, 1000 CFM, 5.3-gallon tank, up to 300 sq ft coverage, 120V/160W/1.66A/60Hz, 3 fan speeds, adjustable + automatic louvers (oscillating), ice tank present, 10-hour timer, remote control, LED digital display, cellulose honeycomb pad, 15.00x12.00x35.50in, 23.35 lbs. newair.com itself returned HTTP 429 on every attempted fetch; Lowe's, Home Depot-style retail pages were not independently reachable, so this manufacturer datasheet is the sole source.

products.name: Portacool APEX 700 Portable Evaporative Cooler
products.provenance: portacool.com's APEX 700 spec sheet (fetched 2026-08-01) confirms: 1,400 CFM, 22-gallon reservoir, 700 sq ft coverage, 37 MPH velocity, 60ft reach, 53dB, oscillating digital louvers, $2,079 MSRP, 27x24x52in, 88 lbs. Corrects the brief's seed 'Portacool Jetstream 250' — no such model exists; Portacool's real (now fully discontinued) legacy line was Jetstream 220/230/260/270, and the APEX series is the current successor lineup, of which APEX 700 is the closest personal/patio-class match. Fan-speed count and wattage/amperage are not published by the manufacturer for this model; no ice compartment is mentioned in an otherwise thorough spec breakdown, so it is set false.

products.name: Portacool APEX 4000 Portable Evaporative Cooler
products.provenance: portacool.com's APEX 4000 spec sheet (fetched 2026-08-01) confirms: 13,250 CFM, 55-gallon reservoir, 4,000 sq ft coverage, 25 MPH velocity, 50ft reach, 62dB, 36in fan, WiFi-enabled CoolSync app control, $4,939 MSRP, 77x63x33in, 220 lbs, 9.0A at 120V (wattage not published, and 9.0A x 120V is not used directly as power_watt since Hessaire's own dual-unit spec sheets show motor wattage does not equal a simple amps x 120V product). Walmart, Home Depot, Tractor Supply, and Lowe's listings (titles only) corroborate '13,250 CFM / 5-speed / 4,000 sq ft'. Oscillation not mentioned in this model's otherwise-thorough spec sheet (unlike APEX 700, which explicitly states it), so set false; no ice compartment appears in any Portacool documentation checked.

products.name: Big Ass Fans Cool-Space 300 Evaporative Cooler
products.priceNote: $2,599 list price per bigassfans.com; the page showed a 23%-off current price of $1,999 as of 2026-08-01.
products.provenance: bigassfans.com/evaporative-coolers confirms Cool-Space is a real, current 4-tier line (300/350/400/500); the Cool-Space 300 product page (fetched twice, 2026-08-01) gives a thorough spec list: 18in fan, 2,800 CFM through 8in resin-treated media, up to 33 degF drop in dry climates, 1,200 sq ft at 63dBA, 16-gallon reservoir good for up to 4 hours standalone or continuous via garden-hose hookup, low-water pump shutoff, variable (not discrete-count) fan/pump speed control, 49in tall x 26in footprint, roto-molded UV-resistant housing, GREENGUARD Gold media, 4 locking casters, 100 lbs, 5-year warranty, $1,999 (23% off $2,599). No oscillating louvers, ice compartment, or wattage/amperage figure appear anywhere in this otherwise-detailed listing, so all three are set false/null rather than assumed.

products.name: Frigidaire EC300W-FA 2-in-1 Evaporative Air Cooler and Fan
products.priceNote: Sold via Lowe's, Walmart, Best Buy, and Bed Bath & Beyond per search listings, but every retailer page returned a bot-block (403/CAPTCHA/error) on direct fetch; no current price independently confirmed as of 2026-08-01.
products.provenance: Corrects the brief's seed model number 'EC300WF' to the real model, EC300W-FA. Its owner's manual (fetched across several pages on manualslib.com, 2026-08-01) confirms: 600 CFM, 110W at 120V/60Hz, noise <=60dB, 4 fan speeds (High/Medium/Low/Silent), timer (1/2/4/8H), Normal/Natural/Sleep modes, automatic horizontal + manual vertical swinging (oscillation), 15.37x13.46x35.33in, 17.64 lbs, and a 14-item feature list plus a 20-part parts list that names a top-loading reservoir and cooling pad but no ice compartment or ice feature anywhere, so ice_compartment is set false. Water tank capacity (5 gal) and coverage (350 sq ft) were not present on the manual pages successfully fetched but are corroborated consistently across five independently-listed retailers (Lowe's, Best Buy, Bed Bath & Beyond, Walmart, Walmart Canada), all of which also agree on '600 CFM / 4-speed'. The manual's registration link points to register.newair.com, indicating NewAir now services this Frigidaire-licensed SKU; frigidaire-store.com (the historical direct storefront for Frigidaire small appliances) now redirects to frigidaire.com's main site with no appliance-specific content.

products.name: Vagkri 2100CFM Evaporative Air Cooler
products.priceNote: Amazon-exclusive brand; Amazon's price could not be extracted from the fetched (JS-rendered) page as of 2026-08-01.
products.provenance: thevagkri.com, the brand's own marketing site (fetched 2026-08-01), confirms: 105W, 2,100 CFM, 700 sq ft coverage, 120-degree oscillation, 3-in-1 modes (air/water/ice) and 3 wind speeds, 24-hour timer, remote control, auto-fill. The Amazon product page (B09MVV2YF4, fetched 2026-08-01) independently confirms the 8-gallon tank from its title. Vagkri is Amazon-exclusive — thevagkri.com has no independent storefront or pricing and funnels every 'shop' link to Amazon; the same 2,100 CFM unit is listed under at least three near-identical ASINs (B09MVV2YF4, B0GL8LCQRR, B0F63LBLX9), and none of the fetched Amazon pages rendered a price in the available HTML.

products.name: Costway 3450 CFM 4-in-1 Industrial Evaporative Air Cooler
